input.error_log: [ERROR] I2C Bus Arbitration Lost - SDA line held LOW. Error Code: 0x08

expected_output_example.root_cause: Design spacing looked acceptable, but manufacturing residue created a conductive bridge between adjacent traces causing a micro-short on SDA.
expected_output_example.impact: I2C communication instability and potential overcurrent risk for connected sensors or MCU pins.
resolution: Remove solder/copper bridge around the highlighted coordinates and re-test continuity.
Request process audit from PCB fabrication line for washing/etch residue controls.
Add AOI gate for bridge-like residue in final inspection.
